Jump to the river

Trail field guide

Setup

Check the compass at the trailhead.

Supplies

Pack water for the ridge.

  1. Meet at the trailhead before sunrise.
  2. Choose a partner and share the map.
  3. Check the wind on the ridge.
  4. Mark the return route.
  5. Fill both water bottles.
  6. Keep the compass level.
  7. Compare the map with the next marker.
  8. Follow the switchbacks.
  9. Stop at the overlook.
  10. Count the group before leaving.
  11. Put the map in its sleeve.
  12. Walk down to the ford.
